builds.hypothesis: E5 active bonus is(10+0.015AP)% target missingHP. AP raises percentage; Q can reduce MR15%; MR modifiers apply to magic bonus. Deathcap multiplies AP; Zhonya adds105AP; Riftmaker adds bonusHP-to-AP and8% full-ramp damage. Void/Shadowflame penetrate MR and amplify eligible low-health hits. Nearby Abyssal makes target take12% more magic damage. 30min Gathering Storm adaptive stats fixed; Absolute Focus requires ownerabove70%HP. First Strike ready but separate proc reported outside target packet; compare inactive.

kitEvidence.formula:
Passive: Attacks deal an additional [15 / 20 / 25 / 30 / 35 + (0.2) × AP + (0.1) × AD[statFormula=2]] magic damage.

Active: Kayle's next attack becomes ranged and deals an additional [(8 / 8.5 / 9 / 9.5 / 10 + (0.015) × AP) × (0.01)] missing Health magic damage. This attack upgrades when Kayle reaches Level @Spell.KaylePassive:LevelForPassiveRank2@, causing it to explode when it hits the target, dealing damage to nearby enemies.

builds.name: Divine Judgment: hybrid explosion
builds.summary: Explore high one Divine Judgment area blast output with explicit finite conditions; compare item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Explore high one Divine Judgment area blast output with explicit finite conditions; compare item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: R explosion deals 200/300/400 + 0.70 AP + 1.0 bonus AD as magic damage. Raw AD can therefore increase the blast, but armor penetration and the invulnerability duration do not amplify the native magic packet.
